verdict.rationale: Jira ships an in-app AI (Rovo AI), so the personalization axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Rovo creating automations, breaking down tasks, surfacing trends and connecting data. Nothing shows the assistant learning a user's tone, shorthand or preferences to tailor its output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
